_comment: Board-build baseline for tools/board_build_check.py.
sha256 here is WHAT THIS TREE BUILDS TODAY. It is not silicon evidence.
The hashes in docs/hardware_evidence.md are what was actually flashed to
a board; these two drift apart legitimately whenever RTL changes. Never
copy a value from this file into a silicon-evidence entry -- that would
assert a bitstream was hardware-tested when it was not.
Only Gowin/Tang targets are listed. The Artix-7 spins need a chipdb
generated from a 464 MB .bba and take far longer; add them once that is
a routine step.
check=builds entries are gated on 'does it still build', not on hash
equality -- full-core spins absorb every core commit so a DIFFERS says
nothing, but a BUILD_FAILED says everything. See hardware_evidence.md 3.6e.
build_25k_spu13_irotc_spi.sh is DELIBERATELY ABSENT: it is BUILD_FAILED and
takes ~8.5 h to fail (router livelock, hardware_evidence.md 3.6f). Adding it
would make this check unusable. Re-add it if it is ever made to route.
RETIRED AS TANG TARGETS 2026-08-16, by decision, not by defect:
series_stream_probe 305%   southbridge 267%   rotc_probe 145%
som_southbridge 127%       som_probe 103%
All five exceed the GW5A-25A's 23,040 LUT4. They are absent from this
manifest because a target that cannot fit cannot be a regression signal --
it would fail every run and train the check to be ignored. Their build
scripts and RTL are kept; each script carries a RETIRED header. Rationale,
measurements and re-entry conditions: hardware_evidence.md 3.6g.
Re-add any of them here if it is trimmed under 23,040 LUT4 and rebuilt.
COVERAGE GAP CLOSED 2026-08-16. The 2026-08-15 sweep reported widening this
check to 21 targets, but four Tang build scripts were never added and stayed
uncovered: blinky_uart, satellite_aggregator_probe, rotc_tagged_probe and
whisper_v1_probe. All four build, all four reproduce, and three of them have
NEVER been run on a board. Coverage is now 26 scripts = 20 checked + 5 retired
(3.6g) + 1 deliberately excluded (irotc_spi).

targets.name: spu4_probe
targets.notes: Baseline moved TWICE since the 2026-07-08 silicon run, and 3.2j stays superseded until one bench session re-runs the probe. (1) 2026-08-15, T7.4 exported dissonance[7:0] from spu4_standalone_top and extended the probe UART line 36->41 chars: 9599f5e4... -> cbd6f83a..., 835 -> 979 LUT4. (2) 2026-08-16, the dissonance residual width was fixed 17 -> 19 bits and the duplicated expression extracted into spu4_dissonance.v: cbd6f83a... -> 0061b02f..., 979 -> 982 LUT4 / 460 -> 462 ALU / 336 DFF unchanged, 160.38 MHz, reproduced 2x. The two moves were deliberately batched before the bench run so one hardware session re-anchors both. Golden line is UNCHANGED by (2) -- 'SPU4:P A=0000 B=0155 C=0155 D=0155 R=FF' -- because the QROT fixture residual of 0x3FF saturates either way; the width bug is only observable past +/-65536, which that fixture does not reach. 9599f5e4... now lives only in hardware_evidence.md 3.2j as the record of what was flashed.

targets.name: six_step_probe
targets.notes: QUARANTINED, not retired: watched on utilisation, not gated on building. It does NOT build -- at 96% occupancy the router congests (67,337 of 109,475 arcs unrouted at iteration 126k; arc rate fell 5.83 -> 1.39 arcs/s over five windows across 68 minutes, i.e. decaying, not converging, so no timeout rescues it). But it FITS, places in 484s, and passes timing at 25.77 MHz against 12 MHz, and it is the only spin sitting on the capacity boundary -- which makes it the early warning for the growth that cost five spins their Tang targets on 2026-08-16. Gating it on buildability would fail every run and train everyone to ignore this check; retiring it would discard the warning. So the gate is occupancy. Cause is growth, not a router anomaly: 13,576 -> 22,212 LUT4 and 1,024 -> 1,600 ALU with DFF unchanged at 1,518, i.e. pure combinational growth. Do NOT group it with irotc_spi, which fails to route at 52% and is a different problem (3.6f). BOTH routing levers are ruled out by measurement, so do not re-try them: a longer timeout (arc rate decayed 5.83 -> 1.39 arcs/s over 68 min, 65,740 of 109,475 arcs still unrouted at iteration 140k) and an alternate router/seed ('--router router2 --seed 7' reached routing iteration 2 with 25,087 wires overused of ~275k -- the same congestion signature, reached sooner). Trimming is the only remaining route to a buildable Tang bitstream. Its 2026-06-30 Tang silicon result (UART 'KIN:P P:5 E:00', 40-second soak) stands as history, and six-step also has A7 ROBOTICS coverage. See hardware_evidence.md 3.6g.
targets.status_2026_08_16: FITS at 96% -- does not route; watched on occupancy

targets.name: spu4_abi_probe
targets.silicon_evidence: NONE YET -- built and simulated only, no board run
targets.notes: First build that instantiates spu4_customer_wrapper, the SPU-4 ABI v1.0 contract layer. Until 2026-08-16 the ABI reached no .ys, no board top and no manifest entry. 1044/23040 LUT4 = 4.5%, 500 ALU, 381 DFF, u_abi.clk closes 160.26 MHz against the 12 MHz constraint, reproduced 2x. NOTE this figure is the PROBE, not the wrapper alone -- it includes the UART engine, the test FSM and the LEDs. Golden line 'ABI:P B=0155 C=0155 D=0155 R=FF S=0A L=0B7', decoded byte-for-byte by spu13_tang25k_spu4_abi_probe_tb (16 checks). L is the MEASURED latency in clocks (0xB7 = 183), matching the simulated 180-183 range and inside the 200-clock ABI bound. Deliberately separate from spu4_probe, whose bitstream is pinned by 3.2j and a pre-registered bench procedure.
